cq_table.question: Which ingredients are made from milk, directly or indirectly?
cq_table.answer: 9 ingredients asserted as made directly from milk; reasoning finds 14 in total.

cq_table.question: Which allergens does Smoky Steakhouse Sauce contain, and through which ingredient?
Which products contradict their own label claims, and why?
cq_table.answer: 10 of 45 claims are contradicted by the products' own composition.

cq_table.question: Which free-from claims are undermined by a 'may contain' warning?
cq_table.answer: Dark Chocolate 70%: Dairy-free claim vs. 'may contain milk'; Nut-Free Granola Bar: Nut-free claim vs. 'may contain tree nuts'

cq_table.question: Which products are unsafe, or need caution, for Liam (peanut and tree nut allergy)?
Which products can be confirmed safe for Liam, and why are others excluded?
cq_table.answer: 34 products confirmed safe; Dark Chocolate 70% blocked by its hazelnut warning

cq_table.question: How is each product classified automatically?
cq_table.answer: 45 of 45 products placed in at least one defined class

cq_table.question: Which allergens must each product declare in the US, Canada and the EU, and where do the markets disagree?
cq_table.answer: 11 product-allergen pairs are treated differently by markets the product is sold in.

cq_table.question: Which products contain an allergen that the ingredient names do not reveal?
cq_table.answer: 10 hidden allergens in 9 products (e.g., caseinate, tahini, surimi)

cq_table.question: Which products cannot be assessed because their ingredient information is incomplete?
cq_table.answer: 2 incomplete records; neither can be confirmed safe for any consumer

cq_table.question: Which gluten-free products meet the 20 ppm limit, which exceed it, and which rely on the recipe alone?
How is a new, previously unseen product classified?
cq_table.answer: NonVeganProduct; vegan claim contradicted; wheat undeclared ((Canada), (European Union))

cq_table.question: Which products have allergens that a market requires but the label does not declare?
cq_table.answer: 10 products carry at least one undeclared allergen in a market where they are sold.

cq_table.question: Which label claims are verified, contradicted, at risk or unverifiable?
cq_table.answer: 30 verified, 10 contradicted, 2 at risk, 2 unverifiable, 1 informational

rule_table.name: Product allergen detection
rule_table.fol: ∀a, i, p: Product(p) ∧ hasIngredient(p, i) ∧ triggersAllergen(i, a) → containsAllergen(p, a)

rule_table.name: Free-from claim contradiction
rule_table.fol: ∀a, c, p: hasLabelClaim(p, c) ∧ excludesAllergen(c, a) ∧ containsAllergen(p, a) → contradictsClaim(p, c)

rule_table.name: Vegan claim contradiction
rule_table.fol: ∀c, p: hasLabelClaim(p, c) ∧ VeganClaim(c) ∧ NonVeganProduct(p) → contradictsClaim(p, c)

rule_table.name: Unsafe for consumer
rule_table.fol: ∀a, p, u: Consumer(u) ∧ mustAvoid(u, a) ∧ containsAllergen(p, a) → unsafeFor(p, u)

rule_table.name: EU declaration duty
rule_table.fol: ∀a, j, p: containsAllergen(p, a) ∧ soldIn(p, j) ∧ EUJurisdiction(j) ∧ requiresDeclarationOf(j, a) → mustDeclareInEU(p, a)

rule_table.name: Gluten-free threshold exceeded
rule_table.fol: ∀c, p, x: hasLabelClaim(p, c) ∧ GlutenFreeClaim(c) ∧ hasGlutenPPM(p, x) ∧ x ≥ 20.0 → contradictsClaim(p, c)

rule_table.name: Sulphites above 10 mg/kg
rule_table.fol: ∀p, x: Product(p) ∧ hasSulphiteMgPerKg(p, x) ∧ x > 10.0 → SulphiteAbove10ppm(p)

rule_table.name: Declaration duty unless exempt
rule_table.fol: ∀a, i, j, p: containsVia(p, a, i) ∧ soldIn(p, j) ∧ requiresDeclarationOf(j, a) ∧ not exemptFromDeclaration(i, a, j) → declarationDuty(p, a, j)

rule_table.name: Undeclared allergen
rule_table.fol: ∀a, j, p: declarationDuty(p, a, j) ∧ not declaresAllergen(p, a) → undeclaredAllergen(p, a, j)

rule_table.name: Hidden allergen
rule_table.fol: ∀a, i, p: Product(p) ∧ hasIngredient(p, i) ∧ triggersAllergen(i, a) ∧ not assertedTrigger(i, a) ∧ not mentionsAllergen(i, a) → hiddenAllergenVia(p, a, i)

rule_table.name: Confirmed safe for consumer
rule_table.fol: ∀p, u: Consumer(u) ∧ Product(p) ∧ hasIngredientListStatus(p, complete) ∧ hasSomeIngredient(p) ∧ not unsafeFor(p, u) ∧ not cautionFor(p, u) ∧ not uncertainFor(p, u) → confirmedSafeFor(p, u)

rule_table.name: Verified vegan product
rule_table.fol: ∀p: Product(p) ∧ hasIngredientListStatus(p, complete) ∧ hasSomeIngredient(p) ∧ not hasNonVeganSafeIngredient(p) → VerifiedVeganProduct(p)
